text: Here's a dating mindset shift that will change everything. Stop being obsessed with the outcome. Too many guys go on dates or approach women with this pressure in their head. She has to like me. She has to give me her number. She has to return my kiss. And when it doesn't happen, they spiral. They think, what's wrong with me? Do I look bad? Did I say something wrong? Am I just not good with women? Here's the truth. It may have nothing to do with you. Maybe she's tired. Maybe she has problems at work. Maybe her dog just died. It's not always about you. What you can control is your own actions. Did you approach her? Did you ask her out? Did you try to make her comfortable? Did you flirt? That's the only scoreboard that matters. If you focus on what you can do, starting conversation, being playful, expressing yourself, you stay confident regardless of her response. That's how rejections stop being failures. They are just part of the process. And if this mindset shift helps you, hit like, subscribe, and share it with a friend who needs to hear this. Trust me, a lot of guys struggle with this exact problem. When you detach from results and enjoy the interaction itself, you become more attractive and less needy. Think of it like this. The outcome is unstable, but your actions are always yours. Every time you express yourself without fear, you win. So stop chasing approval. Stop obsessing over results. Focus on enjoying the interaction itself. That's how you stay confident, grounded, and ironically, that's when women are most drawn to you.
